text:
laura-release: Heads up — EU dedicated pool (eu-west-1) has a ~5% increase in 5xx starting 08:42 UTC after the 2.5.1 rollout. Deploy-bot flagged elevated error-rate and p95 regressed. Thinking we should manual-partial-rollback the dedicated-eu pool to 2.5.0 while we triage. 의견?

deploy-bot: @channel Telemetry: error_rate +5.1% over baseline (10m window). Suggested actions: throttle rollout to 10% OR revert dedicated pool to previous version. Recommend: manual rollback for dedicated pools. :warning:

miguel-eng: +1 for targeted rollback to 2.5.0 for dedicated-eu only. We can keep hosted API on 2.5.1. Need to pin model-serving image and drain connections first.

sam-sre: Can we get the request traces and ingress error split? If it's KV cache related we should hold. Pulling graphs now — give me 2 mins.

laura-release: Thanks. bob-ops — can you outline the minimal rollback steps for dedicated-eu and who can execute? We want minimal customer impact and an update to dedicated customers.

bob-ops: Runbook (condensed):
1) mark pool read-only: `infractl pool set dedicated-eu --drain`
2) pin version: `infractl pool set-image dedicated-eu redwood/inference:2.5.0`
3) wait for drain then `infractl pool resume`
4) verify p95/errors for 10m window, rollback if metrics ok keep pinned until root cause fixed.
I can run 1-2 if @miguel-eng helps with step 3 verification. ETA ~15-20m.

miguel-eng: I can be on step 3/4. Will watch logs and KV cache metrics. If we see any perf regression on 2.5.0, abort and escalate.

sam-sre: Graphs: ingress errors are concentrated on short-lived jobs hitting kv-lookup path. Not seeing host-level OOMs. Putting overlay now: `https://grafana.redwood/influx/d/..../dedicated-eu`

nina-pm: I'll draft the customer message for dedicated customers (short, factual, apologetic, ETA for follow-up). Who owns posting to status.redwood?

laura-release: @nina-pm please draft. @bob-ops please run the rollback. @miguel-eng validate metrics. I'll coordinate comms and send a quick CSE heads-up after rollback.

deploy-bot: Action scheduled: manual-rollback queued by bob-ops. Reminder: rolling pin will create brief 10-30s connection resets per instance.

bob-ops: Starting step 1 (drain) now.

miguel-eng: watching logs — KV cache hit-rate drops during the spike, tracing sample attached. If this reappears on 2.5.0 we need to flip feature-flag `kv-optim` off.

laura-release: Good call. If rollback reduces errors, we'll keep pinned and open issue to revert with a patch. If not, we'll escalate to SRE war room.

nina-pm: Draft ready and sent to #customer-ops for review. Short note: "We identified increased errors in EU dedicated pool after an upgrade; we are reverting to previous version for affected pools and will follow up with root cause."

bob-ops: Pin complete, resuming pool. Verifying health...

miguel-eng: p95 back to baseline after ~3m, errors down to normal. Looks good.

laura-release: Great. I'm posting to status page in 10. Keeping pin until root cause fix. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

sam-sre: Filing post-mortem ticket and assigning to miguel-eng and infra. Link: https://tickets.redwood/PM-1234

deploy-bot: Note: rollback was manual; automated rollback thresholds unchanged.

laura-release: Closing thread — follow-up in PM-1234.
